source_policy: Original issuer, investor and regulatory sources; original journalism; credible public professional financing records. Discovery aggregators are leads and do not supply uncorroborated financing facts.
financial_limits: All 21 carried-forward claims were reassessed. One seed disclosure was corroborated; 20 still lack sufficient public evidence for the claimed additional financing or timing. Quarantined claims are not proven missing deals.
The 61 categories and three periods each received a targeted public search. Search-engine date filters and absent results are not authoritative financing dates or evidence of zero market activity.
No independent comprehensive commercial export or market denominator was available. Market recall remains unmeasured; this completed search pass does not certify worldwide completeness.

The fixed taxonomy excludes general cybersecurity with incidental AI, standalone advertising optimization and ordinary weather intelligence. Such verified financing context remains visible with an explicit outside-framework flag.

Regulatory offering amounts sold, allocations, note conversion and public-disclosure dates are not certified newly received cash. Overlapping or unallocated offerings remain outside framework deal counts.
Year-only backing and combined seed-plus-Series-A funding with unallocated dates or amounts remain outside comparable period counts.
Company/product classifications describe the cited business evidence. Current pages do not establish a historical pivot day or validate product performance.
Most routine amount differences are retained at credible ballpark precision. Material currency, cumulative-funding and duplicate-episode errors are reconciled. Unknowns remain unknown.
